name: Life Time Group Holdings, Inc.
summary: Life Time Group Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides health, fitness, and wellness experiences to a community of individual members in the United States and Canada. The company offers fitness floors with equipment, locker rooms, group fitness studios, cycle, yoga, pilates studios, bar and lounge, free weight and resistance equipment, cardiovascular equipment, steam room and sauna, cold plunges, racquetball and squash spaces, recovery spaces, indoor and outdoor pools and bistros, indoor and outdoor tennis and pickleball courts, basketball, volleyball courts, LifeSpa, LifeCafe, and childcare and kids academy learning spaces.
